card.name: The End is Beautiful
card.text: The End is Beautiful enters with three time counters on it. At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, remove a time counter on The End is Beautiful. Then if it has no time counters on it, that player sacrifices all creatures you control. If no creatures were sacrificed this way, they lose 7 life.

card.name: Master of the Wild Hunt
card.text: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token. {T}: Tap all untapped Wolf creatures you control. Each Wolf tapped this way deals damage equal to its power to target creature. That creature deals damage equal to its power divided as its controller chooses among any number of those Wolves.

card.name: Solar Pilgrimage
card.text: Flash When Solar Pilgrimage enters, if it was foretold, create a 2/2 white Angel creature token with flying. Whenever you cast a foretold spell, create a 2/2 white Angel creature token with flying. Foretell {1}{W} (During your turn, you may pay {2} and exile this card from your hand face down. Play it on a later turn for its foretell cost.)

card.name: Isidra's Hunt
card.text: When Isidra's Hunt enters, target opponent creates a blue Teferi planeswalker token named "Signs of Teferi" and put 2 loyalty counters on it. Whenever a planeswalker an opponent controls dies, its controller reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card.

card.name: Woods' Procession
card.text: Whenever one or more creatures you control lose toughness, induct. This ability only triggers twice per turn. (Create a 0/1 Cleric creature token with "As a sorcery, sacrifice two other Clerics: Transform into a 4/4 God Horror that can't block.")

card.name: The Incursus
card.text: Pathbound—Sacrifice two Clerics. (As a sorcery, reveal this, then put this on top of your library from your sanctum by paying its pathbound cost.) Look at the top seven cards of your library. Put up to two permanent cards with mana value 3 or less from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

card.name: In the Arms of the Mother
card.text: Pathbound—Sacrifice two Clerics. (As a sorcery, reveal this, then put this on top of your library from your sanctum by paying its pathbound cost.) As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature. Put a creature card from your sanctum with mana value X or less onto the battlefield, where X is 1 plus the sacrificed creature's mana value.

card.name: Conflagration of the Heart
card.text: Pathbound—Sacrifice two Clerics. (As a sorcery, reveal this, then put this on top of your library from your sanctum by paying its pathbound cost.) Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control. It gains haste until end of turn and deals damage to you equal to twice its mana value. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.

card.name: Life, Unending
card.text: Pathbound—Sacrifice two Clerics. (As a sorcery, reveal this, then put this on top of your library from your sanctum by paying its pathbound cost.) Double the size of target creature until end of turn. You gain life equal to its power or toughness, whichever is greater.

card.name: Feast of the True Birth
card.text: Pathbound—Sacrifice two Clerics. (As a sorcery, reveal this, then put this on top of your library from your sanctum by paying its pathbound cost.) Search target opponent's library for a card and exile it. That player shuffles. You foretell that card. Its foretell cost is equal to its mana cost reduced by {2}. Mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.

card.name: Nothing Must be Forgotten
card.text: Pathbound—Sacrifice two Clerics. (As a sorcery, reveal this, then put this on top of your library from your sanctum by paying its pathbound cost.) Return to your hand all cards in your graveyard that you sacrificed this turn.

card.text: As an additional cost to cast this spell you may sacrifice a Sanctuary. Abandon the Church deals X damage to each creature, where X is the number of Sanctuaries you control. If this spell's additional cost was paid, Abandon the Church deals twice that damage instead.

card.name: Fruitfulness
card.text: You may play lands and cast spells from your graveyard. Whenever one or more cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere, exile those cards and you get a poison counter. At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice Fruitfulness or you get two poison counters.

card.name: Rite of Rebel Striving
card.text: Choose three. You may choose the same mode more than once. • Destroy target artifact. • Exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn you may play that card. • Choose two target creatures controlled by different players. Rite of Rebel Striving deals 2 damage to those creatures.

card.name: Omnipresent Ultimatum
card.text: Choose one or more — • Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. • Put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. • Put a creature card from your sanctum onto the battlefield.
